name: melvynx/video-agent-skills
description: A video agent skill collection with 13 skill folders (broll, clips, codex-images, editing, insta-audit, outliers, publish, short-editing, short-translate, steal, studio-script, studio-setup, vox). The samples read, short-editing and publish, cover short video editing and publishing with an approval gate before publishing.
install: npx skills add Melvynx/video-agent-skills -a claude-code (add -g for every project), or git clone plus copy of skills/* to .claude/skills/. For publishing, use only the MCP route or the manual kit route, never the Treg pipe line.
